language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi, my name is Susan.
Right now, it’s evening in the clouds and I have come to this castle to spend some time with my cousin, Annie.
My aunt wants us to give a new look to several rooms in the castle.
We’re very excited about it!
We are planning to change the curtains and carpet.
To do this, we will have to measure the area and perimeter of different items in the room.
For example, to know how much paint we need for the window frames, we need to measure the perimeter of the windows.
This is the sum of all sides: 2 plus 3 plus 2 plus 3 meters.
That’s a perimeter of 10 meters!
To calculate how large the curtains should be, we need to know the area of the windows.
This is the width, multiplied by the height of the window.
So, 3 meters multiplied by 2 meters… is 6 meters!
Susan, now you can say that the area of the window is 6 meter square.
Thanks Chip! I didn’t know that. The area is 6 meter square.
Let’s go decorate Annie’s room!
